evidence.snippet:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION search_documents(
    p_tenant_id UUID,
evidence.why: tenant_id is accepted as a caller-supplied parameter rather than derived from the verified session (auth.uid()/profiles lookup).
SECURITY DEFINER bypasses RLS entirely, so the client-supplied p_tenant_id becomes the sole authorization check, letting any authenticated user query any tenant's documents.
Ownership/tenant predicate is bound to an unverified client parameter instead of the session identity, inside a SECURITY DEFINER function that bypasses RLS.
